description: Flat metadata schema for multidimensional calcium imaging datasets of olfactory neurons in Drosophila exposed to odorant stimuli using two-photon microscopy.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this imaging record, trial, or metadata row.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking records from the same experiment/session or biological preparation.

specimen_id.descr: Identifier for the individual fly specimen or preparation source.

species.descr: Organism species; expected value: Drosophila melanogaster.

strain_or_genotype.descr: Fly strain or genotype used in the experiment, e.g. GAL4 driver, reporter line, mutant background.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the specimen, if known; e.g. male, female, mixed, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the fly in days at the time of imaging.

developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage, e.g. adult, larva, pupa.

brain_region.descr: Primary brain region imaged, e.g. antennal lobe, mushroom body, lateral horn.

subregion_or_glomerulus.descr: More specific anatomical subregion or glomerulus name if applicable.

neuron_type_or_population.descr: Neuron class or population imaged, e.g. olfactory sensory neuron, projection neuron, interneuron.

roi_id.descr: Unique identifier for the region of interest within the image.

roi_anatomical_label.descr: Anatomical label assigned to the ROI, if different from ROI ID.

roi_method.descr: Method used to define the ROI, e.g. manual, automated segmentation, threshold-based.

roi_area_px2.descr: Area of the ROI in square pixels.

roi_volume_px3.descr: Volume of the ROI in cubic pixels for 3D stacks, if applicable.

calcium_indicator.descr: Calcium indicator used, e.g. GCaMP6f, GCaMP7s, jGCaMP8.

indicator_delivery_method.descr: How the indicator was expressed or loaded, e.g. transgenic expression, viral delivery, dye loading.

microscope_type.descr: Imaging platform used, expected to be two-photon microscope.

imaging_modality.descr: Imaging modality, e.g. two-photon fluorescence calcium imaging.

objective_magnification.descr: Objective magnification used during imaging, e.g. 20x, 40x.

objective_na.descr: Numerical aperture of the imaging objective.

emission_bandpass_nm.descr: Emission filter bandpass in nanometers, if applicable.

frame_rate_hz.descr: Acquisition frame rate in frames per second.

pixel_size_um.descr: In-plane pixel size in micrometers per pixel.

z_step_um.descr: Axial step size in micrometers for volumetric imaging, if applicable.

field_of_view_um.descr: Imaged field of view in micrometers, optionally encoded as width x height or a descriptive string.

recording_duration_s.descr: Total duration of the imaging record in seconds.

time_resolution_s.descr: Temporal resolution of the recording in seconds per frame or sample.

odorant_name.descr: Name of the odorant stimulus presented, e.g. apple cider vinegar, ethyl acetate, isoamyl acetate.

odorant_chem_name.descr: Chemical or IUPAC name of the odorant, if available.

odorant_cas_number.descr: CAS registry number of the odorant, if available.

odorant_concentration_units.descr: Units for odorant concentration, e.g. %, M, mM, µM, ppm.

odorant_exposure_time_s.descr: Duration of odorant presentation in seconds.

odorant_pulse_onset_s.descr: Time of odorant onset relative to recording start, in seconds.

odorant_pulse_offset_s.descr: Time of odorant offset relative to recording start, in seconds.

odor_delivery_method.descr: Method used to deliver odorant, e.g. olfactometer, airstream dilution, puff delivery.

stimulus_repetition_number.descr: Trial or repetition index for the odorant stimulus within the experiment.

inter_stimulus_interval_s.descr: Time between stimulus presentations in seconds.

baseline_duration_s.descr: Duration of pre-stimulus baseline period in seconds.

anesthesia_used.descr: Whether anesthesia was used during preparation or imaging.

immobilization_method.descr: Method used to immobilize the fly, e.g. mount, glue, wax, head-fixation.

temperature_c.descr: Temperature during imaging in degrees Celsius.

humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity during imaging, in percent.

data_file_path.descr: File path or persistent identifier for the raw image data file.

data_file_format.descr: Raw image data format, e.g. OME-TIFF, HDF5, TIFF stack, ND2.

analysis_file_path.descr: File path or identifier for derived analysis outputs, if available.

signal_extraction_method.descr: Method used to extract fluorescence traces from ROIs, e.g. ΔF/F0, neuropil-corrected trace.

baseline_correction_method.descr: Method used for baseline fluorescence estimation, if applicable.

quality_flag.descr: Whether the record passed quality control and is considered usable for analysis.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes on data quality, artifacts, motion, photobleaching, or exclusions.

principal_investigator.descr: Name or identifier of the responsible investigator or lab, if needed for provenance.

institution.descr: Institution where the experiment was performed.

acquisition_date.descr: Date of image acquisition in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, if available.
